claim_a: Contact-GraspNet runs in 0.28 s for a full scene or ~0.19 s for a local region, which is faster than other 6-DoF grasp generation methods.
claim_b: GraspGen achieves SOTA results surpassing Contact-GraspNet (Sundermeyer et al., 2021) and M2T2 (Yuan et al., 2023) by 16.9 % and 7.8 % respectively.
